card.name: Start of thromboembolism and thrombosis
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word thromboembolism or thrombosis, split as throm or Th-rom, right after venous, arterial or cerebral. Also fires on a few other adjectives that begin a medical term.

modes.label: Throm- after venous or arterial
modes.description: The opening piece of thromboembolic or thrombosis terms after a vessel-type word in risk and warning lists.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the opening of the word thromboembolism when it follows venous or arterial in a list of clotting risks.
